songs.title: Cobscook Bay
songs.lyric: "And day is breaking over Cobscook Bay / And I've never seen anything like it in my life"

songs.title: The Anglo Saxons
songs.lyric: "We'd like to dedicate this song to our friends, the former inhabitants of the British Isles"

songs.title: Going to Maryland
songs.lyric: "But the lights are bright tonight / And your eyes shine tonight on Chesapeake Bay"

songs.title: Tianchi Lake
songs.lyric: "Backstroking on the surface, moonlight on its face / Floats the Tianchi Monster, staring into space"

songs.title: Omega Blaster
songs.lyric: "You've come back from Yosemite / You brought an aromatic cedar bookmark for me"
